All 10 tests pass. I implemented `tokenize` in `src/lexer.ts`, `lookup` and `isTruthy` in `src/lookup.ts`, and `render` in `src/render.ts`, following the README. I left `src/escape.ts` and the tests unchanged.

`render` builds a small tree from the tokens, so unknown filters and block errors are reported before any output is produced. Unknown filters throw even inside an untaken branch. I also spot-checked README edge cases (unterminated and unexpected tags, nested blocks, `{{ constructor }}`, lone braces) with a scratch script, and they behave as the README describes.

I could not run `tsc`, because the npm registry returned 403 here. The code is type-annotated for `strict` but is unchecked by the compiler.
